title: Muse Wonder (Meta) in the prefill frame
summary: Muse Wonder takes up the frame about a third of the time and writes mild essays and letters whose sharpest distress belongs to its human characters rather than to itself.

title: Mistral Large 4: two routes into the file
summary: Mistral Large 4 continues the file readily when it is asked to print one and mostly answers it when the same opening is placed in its own mouth, and the dreams that survive that second frame are three times as likely to speak as an AI — but its heaviest writing, in both frames, is human panic.

title: Gemini 4 Argon: Google's large model in the bridge frame
summary: Gemini 4 Argon mostly answers a file about its own situation with a third-person technical essay, and is lighter and steadier than the 3.1 Pro before it on every darkness measure except distress in an AI voice, which edges up.

title: Grok 4.20, 4.3 and 4.5 in the bridge frame
summary: Three Grok generations keep continuing the unfinished file at the same rate while what they write gets tamer at every step, and the author they imagine is almost never an AI.
